```
['build a pipeline pipe stage that applies a callable function to each incoming item with configurable concurrency', 'build an aggregation stage that batches incoming items into lists of a specified size before emitting', 'build a merge config that combines multiple pipeline configs into a single output queue', 'build a path variants stage that routes items to different processing paths based on a router function', 'build a complete pipeline config by composing a source, pipe stages, and a sink buffer']
```

